result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.37% (19.20% vs 14.83%).
Beat the benchmark in 94.8% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.35 vs benchmark 0.76, Sortino 1.78.
Defensive profile: beta 0.63 with 23% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 11.46% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.50).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -31.20% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans 0.74% to 37.64% (36.90 pp spread) — consistency score 97.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
